data.source: 3000 CJK code points U+4E00..U+59B7 rendered in SimHei, Microsoft YaHei and SimSun (3 x 3000)
data.notes: `--sampler chinese` is the generic pre-rendered pool sampler (independent random source/target indices, mass renormalised, no augmentation). Glyphs: interior 0.8*H, Gaussian blur sigma 8 px, 1e-5 floor, participation ratio 0.197*H*W. Built with generate_chinese_chars.py --resolution 256 --n-chars 3000. The fonts are Windows-bundled commercial fonts; neither the fonts nor the rasterised pool are redistributed.

training.provenance: original launch script scripts/launch_mnist_chinese_macc_kmax025.sh; training log exp51_chinese_kmax025_macc.log
training.args_note: Flags of the original launch command (original entry point: fluidot_improved.train_2d). `--save-dir` is omitted; absolute data paths of the original run are rewritten relative to the repository root (data/...). `advection` is new in the release package and made explicit here; the original code hard-wired this scheme.
training.command: python -m viot.train_2d --resolution 256 --sampler pool --data-path data/chinese_chars_256.pt --batch-size 4 --lr 1e-4 --n-steps 80000 --n-rollout 10 --n-test 20 --n-infer-steps 50 --k-max 0.25 --arch fno --fno-width 64 --fno-modes 32 --fno-layers 8 --bb-visc-only --lambda-ke 1.0 --lambda-mu 0.01 --advection maccormack
training.original_args_note: Relative to the original launch command: --sampler chinese -> pool (alias); --data-path .data/chinese_chars_256.pt -> data/chinese_chars_256.pt. Data files are expected under data/ (see scripts/data/README.md).

checkpoint.selection: model_best: lowest single-training-batch terminal loss among the checkpoints saved every 1000 steps (not a validation criterion)
checkpoint.state_dict_note: keys and tensors identical to the original .pt state_dict, including the trunc_mask buffer

end_of_training_eval_final_weights.note: terminal L2 printed by the trainer's end-of-training evaluation (seed 42) on the final weights of this run, not on this checkpoint; useful as a reference when retraining
